text_block_list.text: Нарита Брайан doesn't show up for training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I go looking for her and find a familiar
face in a
nearby bathhouse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With hot water that good, there's only
one thing
to pair it with!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heh, that hits the spot—right in my core.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Тренер? What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I guess I soaked too long. ...My bad.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I warn Нарита Брайан to be more careful
from now
on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
